name: 614-batchdecode-tinyllama-1gpu
model: TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0. Ungated; ~2.2 GB of bf16 weights.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 22 layers, 32 query heads over 4 KV heads (GQA 8:1), head_dim 64, hidden 2048, intermediate 5632, vocab 32000, 2048-token window, untied lm_head.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 3000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: prompts centred on 512 tokens (stdev 64, clamped 384-640) and generations centred on 512 tokens (stdev 32, clamped 448-576), sent to /v1/completions rather than the chat route, seed 42.
purpose: A compact chat assistant drafting half-page replies for 64 concurrent users from single-turn prompts on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang at commit 65c65776969dddb50f198c4790f801a0d55137ff (`git describe` = v0.1.19-6-g65c65776969).
# Flat `key: value` only: an indented block is DROPPED by the engine's line reader and the
# server then starts without the mechanism this file declares.
# CUDA graphs and the flashinfer attention path are ON (the engine default) and that is the
# declared operating point; `--disable-flashinfer` also turns CUDA graphs off, silently.

model-path: TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0
tp-size: 1

# ~65 GB of KV pool, ~2.9M tokens. Pinned rather than left to __post_init__, which picks 0.88.
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

# One SSE chunk per token. The dataclass default at this commit is 8, which would make
# guidellm's `inter_token_latency_ms` a chunk cadence rather than a token cadence.
stream-interval: 1

random-seed: 42

# host / port are supplied at launch; context-length comes from the checkpoint (2048).
